title: Contemplative Sushi
description: Meghan caught in a moment of thoughtfulness at the sushi bar, lit by the glow of plates passing by on the conveyor. She's got her phone in hand, probably browsing memes or sushi options, but her gaze is somewhere else entirely. It's a quiet little snapshot of the in-between moments I love capturing.

title: Skyline Reflections
location: Perot Museum of Nature and Science
description: Looking out at the Dallas skyline from the upper floor of the Perot Museum, Meghan is silhouetted in a moment of quiet awe. I snapped this shot while she took in the city from behind the glass, and the framing turned out almost poetic—just her, the city, and a whole world of possibilities stretching out below.

title: Flying Tiger
description: Meghan stands in front of a vintage biplane decorated with a whimsical flying tiger—her expression calm and content. I love this moment, where vintage aviation meets modern geeky charm. That's her in her GitHub hoodie, and yep, I took this photo because she looked effortlessly cool beside that plane.
